name: Husbands
overview: Scripture teaches that a husband is to cleave to his wife, becoming one flesh with her, as shown in Genesis 2:24. The example of Jacob calling Rachel and Leah to the field (Genesis 31:4-7) illustrates a husband's responsibility to care for and protect his family, even amidst difficulties. Ecclesiastes 9:9 encourages husbands to live joyfully with the wife they love throughout their lives, emphasizing the blessing and duty of loving companionship within marriage.
